# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS

@@ Basic Math
@stat: Re
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for everyday math. This includes simple
  counting up through proficiency at basic mathematical manipulations.
  Generally, the major mathematical functions (multiplication, division,
  addition, subtraction, etc.) may quired through the use of this skill. At
  much higher levels, geometry and even algebra is possible. Calculus,
  trigonometry, tensor math, etc. all require the acquisition of Advanced

@@ Research
@stat: SD
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for using multiple sources reference to
  assimilate the knowledge and information necessary to solve a problem,
  support a creative effort, or otherwise questions important to the
  individual. It includes the skills sary to organize and effect a search
  through reference material, and collate the results. Note that skill is
  necessary for the creation of new spell lists. If appropriate materials are
  available, a successful skill roll using such materials will give up to a
  +40 modification to a related Lore skill roll.  Rolemaster Standard Rules
  186

@@ Advanced Math
@stat: Re
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for using higher levels of mathbe acematics
  (e.g., calculus, differential equations, basic relativity, skill in etc.).
  You must develop a higher skill rank in Basic Mathematics (e.g., if your
  rank in Basic Math is 12 you may only develop Math. skill to 11 skill
  ranks).

@@ Anthropology
@stat: Em
@description:
  This skill provides knowledge of linguistic trends, customs, of habits and
  cultural trends of any known races and cultures. Skill may be developed
  in-depth of a specific race or culture from your answer home world. Several
  different anthropology races or cultures necesmay be developed
  simultaneously, assuming research materials are available.

@@ Alchemy
@stat: In
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for identifying and mixing various non-magical
  substances with relatively predictable results. ids, itching powders,
  toxins, etc. are just a few of the possible results. Some combinations the
  GM may deem inappropriate his world (e.g., he might disallow gunpowder or
  petroleum products). Allows user to know elemental composition, reactions,
  compounds, etc. Skill is modified from -30 to -70 for lack of laboratory
  equipment, supplies, etc.

@@ Astronomy
@stat: Pr
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for stellar analysis and survey. Skill is
  useful for aiding in divinations, and detailed knowledge stars, planets,
  moons, etc.

@@ Biochemistry
@stat: In
@description:
  This skill allows understanding and analysis of basic biochemistry and
  genetics for the life forms of a specific area.

@@ Psychology
@stat: Pr
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus for recognizing and identifying major
  insanities (including manias, phobias, depressions, dementia, etc.) and
  attempting to heal or correct them. Must developed either in-depth for a
  specific race or in general trends of multi-cultural racial makeups.
  Several races may be developed simultaneously provided research materials
  are available. Gamemaster Law for more information on psychological
  disorders and their effects.  Slight Mental
